describe: make a whole game where you dodge or avoid things
guide: A new thing needs three pieces in three places, and with only two it does nothing: create it once ABOVE the game loop, move it INSIDE the loop, and draw it inside the loop AFTER screen.fill(...). Give its speed, size and colour named constants at the top.
For a dodging game, make several things that drift across the screen and come back round, and check player.collidelist(things) every frame.
report: I added $what. $touch Move with the arrow keys and keep out of their way. $ship
Here's a start: $what. $touch Dodge them with the arrow keys. $ship
I made it a dodging game: $what. $touch $ship
teach: The things are made once above the loop, moved every frame inside it, and drawn after screen.fill, and a collision check sends you back when one hits.
_note: needs_words: a whole game is only built when the child asks for a game. Measured (SPIKES.md section 25N): as one part of a longer message, 'add some walls i have to get around' was read as this recipe at 1.00.
